turnaround_reason: Legacy Atkins brand is in structural decline (net sales -24.6% in Q3 FY26) and dragged the whole company; total net sales fell 6.3% and FY26 guidance was cut, driving the stock from ~$27 to ~$10. Recovery hinges on Quest and OWYN growth offsetting Atkins and on the newly outlined margin/brand-investment turnaround plan.
bullish_points: Cheap on every metric: forward P/E ~6, P/B 0.64, EV/EBITDA 5.7, EV/Rev 0.88
Strong FCF ($107M) and operating margins ~12.8% despite the sales dip
Quest (+1.1%) and OWYN (+3.6%) still growing; Quest is the real franchise
Trading near 52-week low ($9.875), 'basing' setup with limited further multiple compression
History of positive EPS surprises (last 4 quarters all beat)
bearish_points: Atkins -24.6% is structural erosion, not a blip; may keep bleeding
Q3 net loss of $52M (likely goodwill impairment on Atkins/OWYN)
OWYN in a 6-12 month distribution reset after a product-quality issue
Category headwinds: GLP-1 appetite suppression + private-label protein
catalyst: Q4/FY26 earnings showing Quest reacceleration and Atkins stabilization under the new three-pillar turnaround plan
suggested_trade: Small starter spot $10.00-10.50; add only on confirmed Quest reacceleration at Q4
key_risk: Atkins decline accelerates and starts to drag Quest/OWYN, with the whole protein-snack category softening
would_skip_if: Q4 shows Quest decelerating or another FY guidance cut
